title: No, Emmanuel Macron did not share a (fake) photo of Melania Trump with Jeffrey Epstein
summary: Social media users are claiming that French President Emmanuel Macron circulated a photo of Melania Trump, the wife of US President Donald Trump, appearing with Jeffrey Epstein. However, the image has been digitally altered and was never shared by Macron. The misinformation began circulating after Donald Trump publicly mocked the Macrons.
